meta.grain: one retail venue / site; parent complexes and retail components are separate rows

boundary.codes: CityMETER production base/info lv0 (abbrEn) and lv1 (district code)

definitions.qualified: venue_qualification_status in the definition-supported family (current, historical, planned) or a category rule the owner accepted (owner_*_definition_accepted_*, owner_confirmed_*; tier "owner", Owner-stated)
definitions.owner: qualified by a category rule the owner accepted and recorded in the registry (ownerRule = rule id); the rule replaces source evidence of a single common manager for that category, it does not add it
definitions.countable: qualified and count_role in managed_site_parent, parent_complex, pending_scope_boundary_review, retail_scope_pending_terminal_boundary, venue_site, venue_site_candidate (unknown roles are not counted and listed in checks.countRoleFallback); a component role (child_component_not_independent_center_count, child_venue, child_zone, component_within_managed_site, retail_component_within_managed_site, retail_subarea_do_not_count_as_separate_parent_mall) without a qualified parent counts as its own venue when it is a shopping centre or mall (display group mall/community, or named by the owner) — owner decision D6, 2026-10-25; held roles (aggregate_context_not_independent_venue, duplicate_candidate_hold, individual_store_context_not_counted_as_venue, retail_component_scope_count_review) are never counted
definitions.supply: countable minus operation_group future_project and closed_source_evidence
definitions.located: a selected reference point (coordinate_status/role); area = point-in-polygon on full-resolution boundaries
definitions.pending: pending_* qualification: not eligible by default, quiet context only, never counted
definitions.unconfirmed: reviewed_*_unconfirmed: the definition review closed without confirming the record; quiet context only (pending.json field state = "reviewed"), never counted
definitions.excluded: a negative determination (e.g. individual_tenant_component_not_independent_venue): not shown, never counted

groupMapping.rule: evidence venue_type from the table first; an evidence type missing from the table takes the first keyword group whose word it contains (basis evidence-keyword), else other; legacy_venue_type only while venue_type is unclassified (basis legacy)

meta.release: research snapshot published as a demo by the owner; registry release_status remains on hold per row (identity, geometry, rights, remaining fields) — not a CityMETER production release
limitations: Not a census of shopping centers or retail venues in Thailand.
Qualified by definition does not confirm the venue is open today; operation status is sourced, not field verified.
Reference points are not entrances; area membership is point-in-polygon of the reference point.
Legacy GLA/GFA values are estimates with a stated basis; they are not official GLA and are never aggregated.
Store links are confirmed observations of other CityMETER research datasets; candidates are not counted.
Counts are not market share, footfall, sales, rent, vacancy or occupancy.

detail.hash: FNV-1a 32-bit of the UTF-8 venue id, modulo shards, decimal padded to two digits
detail.sizing: at least 32 shards, doubled while the average exceeds 40 venues per shard
